points.title: 书香门第
points.description: 徐霞客出生于江苏江阴一个书香门第，原名徐弘祖。自幼受到良好教育，博览群书，尤其喜爱地理、历史和游记类书籍。父亲徐有勉是当地著名学者，对徐霞客影响深远。这一时期，徐霞客接受了系统的儒家教育，但已显露出对传统科举考试的不感兴趣，反而对地理考察表现出浓厚兴趣。
points.descriptionEn: Xu Xiake was born into a scholarly family in Jiangyin, Jiangsu Province, originally named Xu Hongzu. He received excellent education from an early age, reading extensively, especially in geography, history, and travel literature. His father, Xu Youmian, was a renowned local scholar who had a profound influence on him. During this period, Xu received systematic Confucian education but showed little interest in traditional imperial examinations, instead developing a strong passion for geographical exploration.

points.title: 初探山水
points.titleEn: Early Exploration of Mountains and Waters
points.description: 22岁时，徐霞客开始了他第一次真正的地理考察，游历了江苏、浙江一带的名山大川。这一时期，他游览了太湖、杭州西湖、天台山、雁荡山等地，详细记录了各地的地理特征、风土人情。他开始形成自己独特的考察方法，注重实地观察而非仅依靠文献记载。这段经历奠定了他一生考察事业的基础，也使他逐渐确立了'读万卷书，行万里路'的人生信条。
points.descriptionEn: At the age of 22, Xu Xiake began his first true geographical expedition, exploring famous mountains and rivers in Jiangsu and Zhejiang provinces. During this period, he visited Taihu Lake, West Lake in Hangzhou, Tiantai Mountain, and Yandang Mountain, meticulously recording geographical features and local customs. He began to develop his unique exploration methods, emphasizing field observation over reliance on written records. This experience laid the foundation for his lifelong career in exploration and helped him establish his life motto: 'Read ten thousand books, travel ten thousand miles.'

points.title: 南国壮游
points.description: 这一阶段，徐霞客的考察范围扩大到福建、江西、湖南等南方省份。他深入武夷山区，考察了九曲溪的地质构造；游览了庐山，详细记录了其地貌特征；在湖南考察了衡山、洞庭湖等名胜。他的考察方法日趋成熟，开始系统记录地质、水文、植被等自然现象，并注重与当地居民交流，收集民间资料。这一时期的考察成果为他后来的《徐霞客游记》积累了丰富的一手资料，也使他的地理考察逐渐从单纯的游山玩水转向科学考察。
points.descriptionEn: During this period, Xu Xiake's exploration expanded to southern provinces including Fujian, Jiangxi, and Hunan. He深入 explored the Wuyi Mountains, studying the geological structure of the Nine-Bend Stream; visited Mount Lu, meticulously recording its landforms; and explored famous sites like Mount Heng and Dongting Lake in Hunan. His exploration methods became more sophisticated, with systematic recording of geological, hydrological, and botanical phenomena, as well as collecting information from local residents. The findings from this period provided rich firsthand materials for his later work 'Xu Xiake's Travelogue' and gradually transformed his exploration from mere sightseeing to scientific investigation.

points.title: 西南远征
points.description: 这是徐霞客考察生涯中最重要、最艰苦的阶段。他历时三年，深入当时交通极为不便的广西、贵州、云南等西南边疆地区。他考察了喀斯特地貌，详细记录了溶洞、地下河等地质现象；研究了少数民族地区的风土人情；记录了大量植物、动物资源。在云南，他考察了滇池、洱海等高原湖泊，研究了高原地理特征。这一时期的考察极为艰苦，他曾多次遇险，甚至差点丧命，但他坚持记录，为后人留下了极为珍贵的西南边疆地理资料。这段经历也使他的地理考察达到了科学的高度，超越了前人的游记传统。
points.descriptionEn: This was the most important and arduous phase of Xu Xiake's exploration career. Over three years, he traveled to the remote southwestern frontier regions of Guangxi, Guizhou, and Yunnan, where transportation was extremely difficult. He studied karst landforms, meticulously recording caves, underground rivers, and other geological phenomena; documented the customs and traditions of ethnic minority regions; and recorded numerous plant and animal resources. In Yunnan, he explored高原 lakes like Dianchi and Erhai, studying plateau geographical features. This period was extremely perilous, with Xu facing numerous dangers and near-death experiences, yet he persisted in documentation, leaving behind invaluable geographical data of the southwestern frontier. This experience elevated his geographical exploration to a scientific level, transcending traditional travel literature.

points.title: 西北考察
points.description: 50多岁的徐霞客继续他的考察事业，前往湖北、四川、陕西等西北地区。他考察了长江三峡的地质构造，记录了三峡的形成过程；在四川考察了峨眉山、青城山等名山，研究了其地质特征；在陕西考察了华山、终南山等山脉。这一时期，他的身体状况已大不如前，但仍坚持考察。他开始系统整理自己的考察笔记，为撰写《徐霞客游记》做准备。这一阶段的考察使他对中国西部的地理环境有了更全面的认识，也为他的游记增添了丰富的内容。
points.descriptionEn: In his 50s, Xu Xiake continued his explorations, traveling to northwestern regions including Hubei, Sichuan, and Shaanxi provinces. He examined the geological structure of the Three Gorges of the Yangtze River, documenting their formation process; explored famous mountains like Mount Emei and Mount Qingcheng in Sichuan, studying their geological features; and investigated mountains such as Mount Hua and Mount Zhongnan in Shaanxi. Although his health had declined significantly during this period, he persisted with his explorations. He began systematically organizing his field notes, preparing for what would become his 'Travelogue.' This phase of exploration gave him a more comprehensive understanding of China's western geography and enriched his travelogue with additional content.

points.title: 晚年著述
points.description: 1640年，徐霞客因长期劳累和旅途艰辛，身体极度虚弱，被友人送回故乡江阴。在生命的最后一年，他专注于整理和撰写《徐霞客游记》。这部巨著记录了他一生考察的所见所闻，包括地理、地质、水文、生物、民俗等多方面内容，是中国古代地理学的珍贵文献。1641年，徐霞客在家乡病逝，享年54岁。他的《徐霞客游记》在他去世后由友人整理出版，成为中国地理学史上的经典著作，对后世地理学发展产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: In 1640, due to years of strenuous travel and hardship, Xu Xiake's health severely deteriorated, and friends brought him back to his hometown of Jiangyin. In his final year, he focused on organizing and writing his 'Travelogue,' a monumental work documenting his lifetime of observations across geography, geology, hydrology, biology, and folklore. This work became a precious document in ancient Chinese geography. In 1641, Xu Xiake passed away at home at the age of 54. His 'Travelogue' was published posthumously by friends and became a classic in the history of Chinese geography, exerting profound influence on the development of geographical studies in later generations.

appraisal.zh: 徐霞客被尊为中国古代最伟大的地理学家与旅行家，一生跋涉大半个中国，坚持实地考察，《徐霞客游记》既是文学名作也是科学文献，他因而被视为传统文人「行万里路」理想的实践者和现代地理学的先驱。也有研究者指出，其记录多凭肉眼观察，缺乏精确测量与实验验证，解释常依托传统阴阳五行之说，且带有文人式的浪漫与主观。这些局限反映的是当时科学发展的整体水平。
appraisal.en: Xu Xiake is honored as China's greatest ancient geographer and traveler, who journeyed across most of the country insisting on field observation; his Travelogue is at once a literary masterpiece and a scientific record, and he is seen as both a practitioner of the scholar's ideal of traveling ten thousand miles and a pioneer of modern geography. Some researchers note that his records rested largely on unaided observation, lacking precise measurement and experimental verification, that his explanations often drew on traditional Yin-Yang and Five Elements theory, and that literary romanticism and subjective judgment crept in. Such limits reflect the general state of science in his time.

supporter.zh: 徐霞客被誉为'中国地理学之父'，是中国古代最伟大的地理学家和旅行家。他一生游历大半个中国，不畏艰险，坚持实地考察，开创了中国地理学实地研究的先河。他的《徐霞客游记》不仅是一部文学杰作，更是一部科学著作，详细记录了中国各地的地理特征、地质构造、水文状况等，为后世研究提供了宝贵资料。徐霞客的精神体现了中华民族勇于探索、追求真理的品质，是中国科学史上的重要人物。
supporter.en: Xu Xiake is hailed as the 'Father of Chinese Geography' and China's greatest ancient geographer and traveler. He traveled across most of China, braving hardships and insisting on field investigations, pioneering empirical research in Chinese geography. His 'Travelogue' is not only a literary masterpiece but also a scientific work, meticulously documenting geographical features, geological structures, and hydrological conditions across China, providing invaluable resources for later research. Xu's spirit embodies the Chinese nation's courage to explore and pursue truth, making him a significant figure in the history of Chinese science.

critic.zh: 从现代科学角度看，徐霞客的考察方法虽然开创性，但仍存在局限性。他的记录多基于肉眼观察，缺乏精确测量和实验验证；对地质现象的解释多基于传统阴阳五行学说，而非现代地质学理论；他的考察范围虽广，但深度不足，对许多地理现象的科学解释有限。此外，作为明末清初的文人，他的游记中也难免带有文人墨客的浪漫色彩和主观臆断，影响了其科学性。这些局限反映了当时中国科学发展水平的整体状况。
critic.en: From a modern scientific perspective, although Xu Xiake's exploration methods were pioneering, they had limitations. His records were mostly based on visual observation, lacking precise measurements and experimental verification; his explanations of geological phenomena often relied on traditional Yin-Yang and Five Elements theories rather than modern geological principles; while his coverage was extensive, the depth was insufficient, with limited scientific explanations for many geographical phenomena. Additionally, as a scholar from the late Ming and early Qing periods, his travelogue inevitably contained romanticized literary elements and subjective judgments that affected its scientific accuracy. These limitations reflect the overall state of scientific development in China at that time.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，徐霞客被定义为一位超越时代的科学探索者和文化符号。他既是中国传统文人'读万卷书，行万里路'理想的实践者，也是现代地理学的先驱。他的《徐霞客游记》被誉为'千古奇书'，既是文学经典，也是科学文献。在当代，徐霞客精神被赋予了新的内涵，代表着勇于探索、求真务实、不畏艰难的科学精神。他的形象已从单纯的地理学家扩展为中国传统文化中探索精神的象征，影响着一代又一代中国人。
objective.en: In historical scholarship and popular culture, Xu Xiake is defined as a scientific explorer who transcended his time and a cultural symbol. He was both a practitioner of the traditional Chinese scholar ideal of 'reading ten thousand books and traveling ten thousand miles' and a pioneer of modern geography. His 'Travelogue' is hailed as a 'book of wonders,' serving as both a literary classic and a scientific document. In contemporary times, the spirit of Xu Xiake has been endowed with new meanings, representing the scientific spirit of courage in exploration, seeking truth, and perseverance in the face of difficulties. His image has expanded from that of a mere geographer to a symbol of the exploratory spirit in traditional Chinese culture, influencing generations of Chinese people.

self.zh: 大丈夫当朝碧海而暮苍梧，岂能局促于山水之间？
self.en: A great man should visit the blue sea in the morning and the dark mountains at dusk; how can he be confined between mountains and rivers?
